health_zone_table.basis: SitRep74 Tableau 2 (2026-07-27) transcribed and reconciled against the INSP PDF (13 pages, sha256 2cc0d9353be3ca04270a82a68497a54c7c7ce58f21ccd9603ccd6997540c45c7); every province and all 48 named zone rows close exactly to the DRC headline.

reconciliation.note: SitRep74 closes at the cumulative boundary: 3262 + 98 = 3360 confirmed and 1437 + 50 = 1487 deaths. Every detailed zone row closes to its province and the five provinces close to the national headline. The source explicitly declares +11 deaths from Nord-Kivu zone harmonization. Therefore the net +50 reconciles mathematically but is not a pure incident-death count.

lab_indicators_24h.note: National aggregate over the four provincial laboratory paragraphs: Ituri 206 analysed / 87 positive (71 living, 16 deaths) = 42.2%; Nord-Kivu 100/11 (6 living, 5 deaths) = 11.0%; Haut-Uele reported no sample; Tshopo 3/0. The 98 positives equal the notified +98. Apparent national positivity is 98/309 = 31.7%; this is a daily testing-process indicator, not a standalone transmission estimate.

care_continuity: SitRep74 reports 733 patients in isolation (313 confirmed / 420 suspected) at 77.3% national occupancy; Ituri 544/808 = 67.3%, while Nord-Kivu remains over capacity at 189/141 = 134.0%.
The bed identity closes exactly: 719 at J-1 plus 140 admissions minus 126 exits equals the 733 end-of-day census.
Five patients escaped isolation in Ituri during the reporting day; none were reported in Nord-Kivu.
Only 175 of 1170 triage units were reported functional, while frontline burden remains 134 confirmed infections and 40 deaths across Ituri and Nord-Kivu.
The SitRep explicitly states that continuity of essential health services is compromised, increasing indirect non-Ebola mortality.
highlights: No new health zone was affected; the footprint remains 48 of 140 zones across five provinces, with 47 active.
The DRC headline 3360/1487 closes exactly from 48 detailed zone rows.
The source declares +11 Nord-Kivu deaths from zone harmonization. Deaths move 1437 + 50 = 1487, but the +50 is a net notification/reclassification value rather than a pure incident-death count.
National contact follow-up is 78.9% (13882/17588), with Ituri at 77.6%, Nord-Kivu at 82.6%, Haut-Uele at 60.0% and Tshopo at 100%; Bunia and Mutwanga were missing at consolidation.
North Kivu remains severely over treatment capacity at 189/141 = 134.0%; the national isolation census rose 723 -> 733.
Apparent laboratory positivity rose to 31.7% (98/309) from 19.9% (62/312), but this daily testing-process measure is not a standalone force-of-infection estimate.
Alert investigation fell to 80.1% nationally and 66.6% in Ituri, despite source prose calling the movement an improvement.

alerts_total.data_gap_note: SitRep74 Tableau 3: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo report; Sud-Kivu is ND. Reporting rows close exactly to 1425 alerts, 1142 investigated, 213 validated living and 108 validated deaths, with 213+108=321 suspects. Missing Sud-Kivu data are not coerced to zero.

challenges.finding: Reluctance toward post-mortem sampling, community resistance and insecurity targeting burial teams delay confirmation, under-estimate cases and disrupt response activities.
challenges.response: Intensify RCCE, involve religious and community leaders, secure teams and increase burial-team capacity.

challenges.finding: Non-payment of providers and strikes in Bunia and Rwampara interrupt response activities including safe and dignified burials.
challenges.response: Regularise provider payment and secure dedicated financing.

challenges.finding: CTE/CT capacity is insufficient: 134.0% occupancy in Nord-Kivu and 67.3% in Ituri, causing admission delays and raising nosocomial-transmission risk.
challenges.response: Accelerate CTE construction and expansion, deploy temporary structures and report bed capacity systematically.

challenges.finding: Contact follow-up remains weak: Ituri 77.6%, Nord-Kivu 82.6% and Haut-Uele 60.0%, leaving transmission chains uninterrupted.
challenges.response: Train, deploy and motivate community relays; reinforce supervision and stabilise reporting completeness.

challenges.finding: Insufficient ambulances and pre-positioning at control points delay transfer and isolation.
challenges.response: Pre-position ambulances including at PoE/PoC and deploy treatment capacity by health zone.

challenges.finding: Insufficient essential medicines and medical inputs weaken holistic case management.
challenges.response: Urgently procure and distribute essential medicines.

challenges.finding: Insufficient IPC inputs and only 175 of 1170 triage units functional raise nosocomial risk; Ituri reports 123 frontline infections/37 deaths and Nord-Kivu 11/3.
challenges.response: Urgently procure IPC supplies and reinforce IPC training.

challenges.finding: Extension to Haut-Uele and Tshopo alongside high mobility raises urban, riverine and cross-border spread risk.
challenges.response: Activate priority PoE/PoC and reinforce cross-border coordination.

challenges.finding: Proximity laboratories at Butembo and Mambasa are not yet installed, prolonging confirmation delays and allowing transmission to remain undetected.
challenges.response: Accelerate deployment of decentralised diagnostic capacity.

challenges.finding: Insufficient financial resources limit implementation across response pillars.
challenges.response: Mobilise resources urgently and advocate with partners.

challenges.finding: Insecurity and limited access linked to CODECO and ADF restrict operations.
challenges.response: Reinforce security coordination and humanitarian access.

challenges.finding: Continuity of essential health services is compromised, raising indirect non-Ebola mortality.
challenges.response: Implement free care effectively and reinforce continuity of essential health services.

contacts_total.data_gap_note: SitRep74 Tableau 4: 17588 contacts under follow-up and 13882 seen = 78.9%. The table yields Nord-Kivu 4056/4908 = 82.6%; adjacent prose saying 85.6% is a typo. Bunia and Mutwanga were unavailable at consolidation. Sud-Kivu follow-up is closed (0/0, NA).

patient_movement_total.data_gap_note: SitRep74 Tableau 6: 733 in isolation at end of day (313 confirmed / 420 suspected) at 77.3% national occupancy over 949 reported beds. Ituri 544/808 = 67.3%; Nord-Kivu 189/141 = 134.0%; Haut-Uele and Tshopo ND. The bed identity closes 719 + 140 - 126 = 733. Exits are 22 deaths + 85 non-cases + 14 recovered + 5 escapes + 0 transfers.

priorities.priority: Relieve North Kivu's 134.0% occupancy immediately; 189 patients remain in 141 reported beds.
Restore alert investigation in Ituri, where only 273/410 alerts were investigated within 24 hours (66.6%).
Raise national follow-up from 78.9% toward the 95% threshold and restore missing Bunia and Mutwanga reporting.
Restore triage and IPC inputs: only 175/1170 triage units were functional, while frontline burden remains 134 infections/40 deaths.
Repair resistance to post-mortem sampling and safe burials through trusted local leadership while protecting response teams.
Fund continuity of essential services alongside outbreak response because the SitRep explicitly reports compromised services and indirect mortality risk.

preserved_conflicts: SitRep74 national headline is DRC-only (3360 confirmed / 1487 deaths); the country-scope snapshot adds Uganda 20/2/11 separately -> 3380 confirmed / 1489 deaths / 608 recovered.
HAUT-UELE CFR CONFLICT: Tableau 1 prints 52.6%, but 21/39 and Tableau 2 both yield 53.8%. Count-derived 53.8% is promoted and the printed 52.6% is preserved here.
NORD-KIVU CONTACT CONFLICT: Tableau 4 records 4056/4908 = 82.6%, while adjacent prose prints 85.6%. The table and arithmetic win; 85.6% is preserved as a source typo.

NORD-KIVU DEATH HARMONIZATION: the source declares +11 deaths from harmonization by health zone. The national boundary closes 1437 + 50 = 1487, but the net +50 must not be read as 50 newly occurring deaths.
ALERT TREND WORDING: the narrative calls 80.1% investigation an improvement, but the prior SR73 rate was 82.7%. The current table values are promoted without the directional claim.
CONTACT MISSINGNESS: Bunia and Mutwanga had no contact data at consolidation. Missingness is not coerced to zero.
